title: Telangana University Contract Faculty to Hold Statewide Protest on November 25

ai.summary: Contract faculty from Telangana state universities plan a statewide protest on November 25 demanding regularisation, job security, revised UGC pay scales, and equal pay for equal work.

facts.claim: contract faculty across state universities will stage a dharna outside the respective administrative buildings from 10 am on November 25
facts.quote: Contract faculty across state universities will stage a dharna outside the respective administrative buildings from 10 am on November 25

facts.claim: They are seeking regularisation of services, job security, revised 7th PRC/UGC pay scales and equal pay for equal work
facts.quote: They are seeking regularisation of services, job security, revised 7th PRC/UGC pay scales and equal pay for equal work

facts.claim: The University Teachers Association Contract – Telangana State (UTAC-TS), which announced the statewide protest on Sunday
facts.quote: The University Teachers Association Contract – Telangana State (UTAC-TS), which announced the statewide protest on Sunday

facts.claim: The association demanded that existing contract faculty, particularly those qualified through NET, SET or PhD, be absorbed into regular service and given job security before fresh recruitment begins
facts.quote: The association demanded that existing contract faculty, particularly those qualified through NET, SET or PhD, be absorbed into regular service and given job security before fresh recruitment begins

facts.claim: It also sought parity in salaries and service conditions and argued that contract teachers perform the same duties as regular faculty
facts.quote: It also sought parity in salaries and service conditions and argued that contract teachers perform the same duties as regular faculty

facts.claim: The association said career progression and fair remuneration remain among its long-pending demands
facts.quote: The association said career progression and fair remuneration remain among its long-pending demands

ai.background_note: Contract faculty in Telangana state universities are demanding regularisation and revised pay scales, which has led to a planned statewide protest.
